behavior.exactCandidate: A persisted occurrence instant is accepted only if the current sealed rule re-derives that exact instant and the instant is inside the REMINDER_LATEST grace. Future instants and rule-external instants are rejected.
behavior.staging: A tampered instant (+500ms) is discarded as MISSED in the same transaction: occurrence MISSED, task/run cancelled, outbox closed, no delivery row, zero synthetic sends.
behavior.supersession: A newer QUEUED occurrence with the same schedule/revision prevents the older staged instant from authorizing bytes; reminderResultAllowed is false and delivery.process returns SUPPRESSED.
behavior.fastIntervals: The exact-candidate check does not compare against the newest rule instant, so an at-grid INTERVAL candidate is still staged and delivered once while an off-grid instant is rejected. A second control plan in the same world sends exactly once.
